description: opcode_typed_anchor architecture with the PPMC-order-5 literal edge replaced by a bitwise mixer over 10 typed/graph context families (bit-prefix + byte orders 0-3, word tails, slot/field/char-class, slot+last-byte, column bucket) with stretch/squash log-odds averaging and a 16-bucket SSE correction.
